column1: #Software_Authors: Takei, Yodai; Pierson, Nico; Shah, Sheel; White, Jonathan; Cai, Long
#Software_Description: dna-seqfish-plus-tissue software was developed for processing the images and barcode calling for the DNA seqFISH+ experiment in tissue sections.
#^labelID: The variable for DBSCAN allele separation. Spots with -1 (spots without enough neighboring spots) were typically filtered out from the analysis.
#^XistID: The variable for active (0) or inactive (1) X chromosome separation, based on Xist chromatin states. Only spots in X chromosome contain this value.
